title.en: Thermodynamics · Track Energy Through a Gas

desc.zh: 拖动活塞、切换等温与绝热过程，从 P–V 曲线面积走到第一定律和卡诺效率上限。
desc.en: Move the piston, compare isothermal and adiabatic paths, then connect P–V area to the first law and Carnot's efficiency ceiling.
